You are the implementation owner for GitHub issue #117 in fengie/mhw-mods. Work only on semantic Windows UI Automation/accessibility-tree control for Heaven Local Bridge.

Rules:
- Current origin/main is canonical truth. The heaven-bridge branch is relay transport only; never merge its queue/results/status history into main.
- Do NOT use Remote Desktop Commander.
- Work in a fresh short-lived worktree/branch named bridge/uia-v05 from latest origin/main.
- Inspect current heaven-bridge/worker.py, tests, README, and current plugin-facing docs before editing.
- Implement bounded semantic UIA discovery/query plus safe structured actions (focus/invoke/value/select/toggle or the smallest robust pattern set supported by Windows UIA). Selectors must fail closed on ambiguity/stale elements. Do not relay password/secret field values; default to metadata-only observation.
- Preserve protocol chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2 and all existing actions.
- Add regression tests for ambiguity, result bounds, unsupported pattern, stale element, sensitive-value redaction, and health capability advertisement.
- Update docs.
- Run python compile, both bridge Python suites, PowerShell parse/operator gate where available, and git diff --check.
- Commit and push the branch. Do NOT merge main yourself; the integration owner will reconcile lanes.
- Final stdout must be compact: branch, commit SHA, changed files, exact tests/pass counts, known limitations/conflicts.
